description: Effective CrowdSec bouncer settings (the API key and the captcha secret are never returned)

enabled.description: Whether the bouncer checks every request. Default: off

api_url.description: Address of the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI). Default: http://127.0.0.1:8080

api_key_set.description: Whether an API key is saved or set by the environment. The key itself is never returned

use_tls_auth.description: Whether a TLS client certificate is used instead of the API key. Needs an https address and both files. Default: off

tls_client_cert.description: Path of the TLS client certificate, a PEM file under /data/crowdsec/; empty when not set

tls_client_key.description: Path of the TLS client key, an unencrypted PEM file under /data/crowdsec/; empty when not set

cache_expiration.description: Seconds an answer of the LAPI is cached in live mode, 1 to 86400. Default: 1

bouncing_on_type.description: Which decision types are enforced: all, ban only or captcha only. Default: all

fallback_remediation.description: What is done with a decision type the bouncer does not know: ban or captcha. Default: ban

request_timeout.description: Timeout of a LAPI request in milliseconds, 100 to 60000. Default: 3000

update_frequency.description: Seconds between downloads of all decisions in stream mode, 1 to 86400. Default: 10

enable_internal.description: Whether internal requests (for example after a rewrite) are checked too. Default: off

mode.description: live asks the LAPI per client IP and caches the answer, stream downloads all decisions regularly and answers from memory. Default: live

scenarios_containing.description: Comma separated strings: only decisions whose scenario contains one of them are enforced; empty enforces all

scenarios_not_containing.description: Comma separated strings: decisions whose scenario contains one of them are ignored; empty ignores none

exclude_location.description: Comma separated paths that are never checked, each starting with /; empty checks all

ban_response.description: How a banned visitor is answered: page (the ban page of Landing pages), redirect (to redirect_location) or status (a status code and no page). Default: page

ban_template_path.description: The ban page file the bouncer reads; it is set by NPMpro and chosen in Landing pages

redirect_location.description: Where banned visitors are sent when ban_response is redirect: an http or https address or a path of the same host

ret_code.description: Status code a ban answers with (page or status); null uses the default, 403 for the page

captcha_provider.description: The captcha service: recaptcha, hcaptcha or turnstile; empty for none

captcha_secret_set.description: A captcha secret key is saved

captcha_site_key.description: The site key from the captcha provider; empty when not set

captcha_template_path.description: The captcha page file the bouncer reads; it is set by NPMpro and chosen in Landing pages

captcha_expiration.description: Seconds a solved captcha stays valid, 60 to 2592000. Default: 3600

appsec_url.description: Address of the CrowdSec AppSec listener; empty turns AppSec off

appsec_failure_action.description: deny blocks every checked request while AppSec cannot be reached, passthrough lets them through. Default: deny

appsec_connect_timeout.description: AppSec connect timeout in milliseconds, 1 to 60000; null uses the bouncer's default

appsec_send_timeout.description: AppSec send timeout in milliseconds, 1 to 60000; null uses the bouncer's default

appsec_process_timeout.description: AppSec processing timeout in milliseconds, 1 to 60000; null uses the bouncer's default

always_send_to_appsec.description: Whether requests of IPs that already have a decision are also sent to AppSec. Default: off

appsec_drop_unreadable_body.description: Whether requests whose body cannot be read are dropped instead of sent to AppSec without a body. Default: on

ssl_verify.description: Whether the certificate of an https LAPI or AppSec address is verified. Default: on

admin_ui.description: The admin UI and CrowdSec: checked (bans, captchas and AppSec, like every host), bans (bans and captchas, no AppSec) or out (not checked)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (name only, never the value)

secret_error.description: Whether a saved key cannot be decrypted and must be entered again

loaded.description: Whether nginx has loaded the bouncer

reachable.description: Whether the last poll of the monitoring reader reached the LAPI

last_contact.description: When that poll ran (ISO 8601 in UTC), null before the first one

error.description: The error of that poll, null when it succeeded

status.description: The state of the bouncer and of its last contact with the LAPI
